statement: Runpod lists H100 SXM on-demand rental at $2.69/hr on Community Cloud and $3.29/hr on Secure Cloud as of its July 27, 2026 pricing update.
why: Published neocloud rental rates for the prior-generation flagship are the standard reference level for what GPU capacity costs to rent.

impact.mechanism: Static rental price level with no stated baseline or change; serves as a display overlay on GPU cloud pricing rather than a directional demand or supply signal.

evidence.excerpt: H100 SXM: Community Cloud $2.69/hr | Secure Cloud $3.29/hr.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published price list, single source, code-stamped secondary.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 5.98 -> 2.69 (tol 1%); sources: Runpod
